data.name: Leeann
data.long_meaning: Leeann is derived from the name Leannan, which means gentle in Irish. The addition of the suffix -ann makes the name mean gentle lion. In biblical terms, the lion is a symbol of courage and strength, making Leeann a name for a strong yet gentle woman.
